work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent CXLV act of the printed Clemens XII sequence. Complete beginning, dispositive sections 1–9, final dating 7047–7052 and subscription/registration 7053–7062. Historical notes at 6751–6754 and 7031–7033 remain attached. Quoted predecessors in the discussion are not issuers. Next CXLVI begins 7065. The printed witness abbreviates the conventional final sanction as Nulli ergo omnino hominum, eie. at 7045; this literal formula abbreviation is retained without expansion, while the operative body and final dating remain printed. Source-extent re-audit found no substantive body replaced by an editorial cross-reference; admission is of this bounded printed witness.
